title: Paul Antonio & Copperplate Lettering
content: Paul Antoniohas worked with theWorshipful Society of Scrivenersin London. One of his jobs was to hand-letter the laws of the land on vellum.He also has lettered millions of envelopes for royal events.He talks about the challenges of the job in theCalligraphy Podcast, where he tells his amazing personal story, growing up in Trinidad in the 1970s, when it wasn't easy to find out information about lettering.In 2018 he wrote an excellentbook on Copperplatelettering.You can see his studio in thisvideo tour.
